Synthetic French speech generated locally with Piper (piper-tts 1.8.0, GPL-3.0 program) and the voice
`fr_FR-siwis-medium` (rhasspy/piper-voices; dataset SIWIS, University of Edinburgh, licence CC BY 4.0).
Attribution: SIWIS database, https://datashare.is.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/2353. Resampled to 16 kHz mono 16-bit.
These files are test fixtures, not human recordings. See manifest.json for the sentences.
